d: Advanced data structures for answering range queries (sum, min, max) and point updates in O(log n) time.
c: Count of Smaller Numbers After Self

p: Segment Trees allow answering range queries (like sum or minimum between index L and R) and updating elements in O(log N) time. The root holds the sum of the whole array, its children hold halves, and leaves hold single elements.
1. Build: Recursively divide array. Leaf is element. Parent is sum of children.
2. Update: Update leaf, then bubble up to update parents.
3. Query: If range matches node range, return value. Else query left/right children.

class SegmentTree:
  # Complex implementation omitted for brevity
  # Focus on the recursion: build(node, L, R)
  # If L == R, node.val = nums[L]
  # Else mid = (L+R)/2, build(left, L, mid), build(right, mid+1, R)
  # node.val = left.val + right.val
Time: O(N) build, O(log N) update/query. Space: O(4N) for the tree array.
